notes: MG1655 diluted from a 30 C overnight culture to OD 0.05 in fresh LB at 37 C and sampled at 0, 20, 80 and 180 min. No phase word or OD at sampling, so growth_phase left out (0 min is right after dilution from overnight cells). No treatment and no named reference condition, so is_control left out. rRNA removal not described; assay_class total_rnaseq is a study_default.
